name: capability_routing
description: Resolves each capability in a CapabilityDemand to the module that provides it, consulting the module registry and dependency resolver. Loads only the modules required for the current request — the runtime embodiment of Constitution Principle 1 (Capability-First Architecture). Never loads a module whose declared conflicts_with are present.

inputs.name: capabilities
inputs.description: Ordered list of AIOS-CAPABILITY-NNNNNN IDs required by the request.

outputs.name: resolution
outputs.description: Resolution { resolved: [{capability_id, module_id, entry_point}], missing: [capability_id], conflicts: [{module_id, conflict_with}] }

side_effects: May request the runtime (AIOS-MODULE-000003) to load resolved modules into the active execution context

error_codes.message: A requested capability has no providing module installed.
error_codes.recovery: Report the missing capability and the pack/module that provides it; do not silently degrade.
Log the cycle, refuse to load, and advise the operator to repair the dependency registry.

error_codes.message: A resolved module conflicts with another already-loaded module.
error_codes.recovery: Block the conflicting pair; surface both module IDs and the declared conflict reason.

examples: capabilities=[AIOS-CAPABILITY-000060] -> resolution.resolved=[{capability_id: AIOS-CAPABILITY-000060, module_id: AIOS-MODULE-000009, entry_point: aios/code/module.json}]
